# ASYNC_CALLBACKS qualification (A4, a4-2)

Generated by `ARIADNE_WRITE_ASYNC_RESULTS=1 go test ./cmd/ariadne -run TestAsyncQualification`:
the whole pipeline (`-profile generic -roots profile`, CHA) on every async fixture, against
its real-JVM oracle (`observed.txt`). *Missed*: bodies the JVM ran that the graph does not
reach from `main`. *To bodies that did not run*: `callback` edges whose target the controlled
run did not execute — may-run edges, each explained below; none is a wrong association
(a task, listener or subscriber linked to a site that does not hand it over).

| Fixture | Slice | Bodies ran | Missed | `callback` edges | To bodies that did not run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `async` | A0–A2 | 10 | 1 | 6 | 0 |
| `continuations` | A3 slice 1, a3-7 | 12 | 0 | 16 | 4 |
| `async-forward` | a3-2 | 13 | 0 | 3 | 0 |
| `async-handoff` | a3-3 | 24 | 0 | 5 | 0 |
| `async-returned` | a3-4 | 20 | 0 | 4 | 1 |
| `async-listeners` | a3-5 | 28 | 0 | 4 | 0 |
| `async-reactive` | a3-6 | 26 | 0 | 14 | 1 |
| `async-completion` | a3-7 | 21 | 0 | 5 | 0 |
| `async-threads` | a4-1 | 12 | 0 | 3 | 0 |

Missed: `async` — `fx.a.Handled#chosenAtRunTime`, a `MethodHandle` whose method name is chosen at
run time (DYNAMIC_LINKAGE L2's documented gap, not this area's).

Edges to bodies that did not run, and why:

- `continuations`: fx.c.Main#failure -> fx.c.Main#lambda$failure$0 — ran (the supplier throws), but `continuations`' oracle records only bodies calling `Ran.here()`
- `continuations`: fx.c.Main#failure -> fx.c.Main#lambda$failure$1 — `thenApply` on a `supplyAsync` stage that always fails — completion of derived stages is not decided (a3-7 decides hand-completed futures only)
- `continuations`: fx.c.Main#failure -> fx.c.Main#lambda$failure$5 — the same: `exceptionally(t -> null)` has no marker
- `continuations`: fx.c.Main#success -> fx.c.Main#lambda$success$0 — `exceptionally` on `completedFuture` — the same
- `async-returned`: ar.Strategy#runTask -> ar.IdleTask#run — a3-4's gate on `Idle#onSelected`, which CHA reaches through `Endpoint#onSelected` though nothing creates `Idle` — the gate is only as precise as the graph's reachability of the returning method (RTA keeps it too)
- `async-reactive`: rx.Main#main -> rx.Upper#onError — a3-6: every emission may end in `onError` (an `onNext` that throws); `Upper#onNext` does not throw on this run
